question: Which state/UT became the 5th fully literate State/UT in India, joining Tripura, Mizoram, Ladakh, and Goa, as celebrated on International Literacy Day 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh became the 5th fully literate State/UT in India, as announced during the International Literacy Day (ILD) 2025 celebrations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh joined Tripura, Mizoram, Goa, and Ladakh as the fifth fully literate state/UT in India.**
 
• The literacy milestone was celebrated on** International Literacy Day 2025** with the** theme "Promoting Literacy in the Digital Era".**
 
• India's literacy rate has increased from 74% in 2011 to 80.9% in 2023–24, marking significant progress.
 
• The ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram has been a major initiative for promoting literacy, enrolling over 3 crore learners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram__

 __
 
• A nationwide literacy program that has enrolled millions of learners and volunteers, providing learning in 26 Indian languages.
 
 
 
• Digital Literacy__
 __
 
• Digital literacy has become an essential part of the literacy movement in India, facilitating access to learning materials and skills development.
 
 
 
• Prime Minister’s Vision__
 
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized education as the foundation of civilization and urged continuous efforts towards universal literacy.
